skills.name: api-discovery
skills.description: Check Treblle for APIs and endpoints that already exist before building new ones, and discover what APIs an organization already has. Use when the user is about to build, add, design, scaffold, or spec a new API or endpoint, OR asks whether something already exists or what APIs exist for a domain (e.g. "do we have a payments API?", "is there already a refunds endpoint?", "what auth APIs do we have?", "I'm going to add POST /invoices").
headings: Discover existing Treblle APIs before building
skills.description_zh: 在开发新 API 或端点前通过 Treblle 检查已有接口，也用于发现组织在支付、退款、认证等领域已有的 API，减少重复建设。

headings: `api-discovery` — don't rebuild an API that already exists
